sector2.deck: Intake authority, package handler + worker, clone pool, Frank, apps (Life First, Office, ScriptForge)

sector3.deck: Comms + networking: Romeo/Juliet, quadengine, translator boundary, Phoenix Net + Mesh, service units

sector4.deck: Core engine: Frank, Helix engine, paging, ring guardian, vault + intake, the crew itself, the verification ledger
